Starting items (12)

Cull450g · A starting item with attack damage and healing on each attack that pays you extra gold for killing minions, plus a 350 gold bonus once you reach the 100 gold limit.
Dark Seal350g · A cheap starting item that gives more ability power each time you get a kill or assist, but loses 5 of them when you die.
Doran's Blade450g · A starting item with attack damage, some health and a little omnivamp (you heal for part of all damage you deal).
Doran's Bow400g · A starting item with attack damage, attack speed and a little omnivamp for champions who hit with basic attacks.
Doran's Helm450g · A starting item with a lot of health plus a little armor and magic resist, so you survive both kinds of damage.
Doran's Ring400g · A starting item for mages with ability power, health and steady mana regeneration, which goes up after you hit an enemy champion.
Doran's Shield450g · A starting item with extra health that heals you over time after an enemy champion hits you.
Gustwalker Hatchling450g · A jungle starting pet that helps you kill monsters and, once grown, gives you move speed when you enter a brush.
Mosstomper Seedling450g · A jungle starting pet that helps you kill monsters and, once grown, gives you a shield out of combat and after killing large monsters.
Scorchclaw Pup450g · A jungle starting pet that helps you kill monsters and, once grown, makes your next attack or ability burn and slow enemies.
Tear of the Goddess400g · A cheap mana item that grows your max mana as you land abilities, up to 360, and later upgrades into a bigger mana item.
World Atlas400g · The support starting item that gives you gold without taking minion kills and later upgrades into your final support item.
